code: import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}tables`;const getTable=async()=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL);return response.data;};const deleteTable=async tableId=>{const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+"/"+tableId);return response.data;};const updateTable=async(tableId,tableData)=>{const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+"/"+tableId,tableData);return response.data;};const createTable=async tableData=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,tableData);return response.data;};const batchDeleteTable=async tableIds=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL+"/batch-delete",tableIds);return response.data;};const tableService={createTable,getTable,deleteTable,updateTable,batchDeleteTable};export default tableService;
